data.description: Explicitly installed and enabled subprocess extensions and configured MCP servers contributing nodes, tools, resources, prompts, providers, evaluators, or adapters. Discovery is inert. Enabled trusted extension code may use the desktop user's full OS authority; the process boundary provides lifecycle isolation, not security isolation.
data.name: Trusted Extensions and MCP Servers
data.technology: JSON manifests, local subprocess RPC, MCP stdio/HTTP
